digest.component_or_area: code review gate / project criteria dispatch
propositions: Project-supplied code-review criteria with non-empty applies_to are dispatched unconditionally on every review without checking changed files, because _activated_code_review_project_criteria never reads applies_to and the criteria are appended after the gate's when: resolution

The applies_to field is stored and retrievable from effective_routing but never validated at overlay load, allowing malformed values (non-list, non-string elements, bare strings) to silently narrow to empty and revert to always-on behavior

applies_to validation and file-matching logic exists for plan-review project criteria (registry.project_trigger_fires, det_gate_rules evaluators) but has no counterpart in code-review, creating asymmetry
Project code-review criteria must be gated against changed files using effective_routing globs and the same changed_files list that the triggers step uses, with empty applies_to meaning always-on
